subject: general
question: What is the rank of India in the World Happiness Report of 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**139.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India has been ranked136 out of 149 countries** in the list of UN World Happiness Report 2021.
 
• The World Happiness Report 2021, issued by the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network, focuses on the effects of Covid-19 and how people all over the world have fared.
 
• It ranks the world's 149 countries on "how happy their citizens perceive themselves to be".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finland has been ranked as the happiest country in the world.**
 
• The Nordic nation is followed by Iceland, Denmark, Switzerland, The Netherlands, Sweden, Germany and Norway.
 
• **Pakistan is on 105th, Bangladesh on 101st and China on 84th.**
 
• **The United States ranks in 19th place for happiness,** despite being one of the richest countries in the world.
 
• **People in war-torn Afghanistan are the most unhappy** with their lives, followed by **Zimbabwe (148), Rwanda (147), Botswana (146) and Lesotho (145).**
